findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite), but the composition declares a finite 78.355s window. HyperFrames clips deterministic seeking and export to that explicit duration.
findings.fixHint: Keep the explicit finite composition `data-duration`. Use a finite repeat count only when the loop itself must end before the composition does.

findings.message: Track 0 has 8 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div id="beatA"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="a-eyebrow">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="beatA"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
